skill.name: ai-html-generate
skill.description: Use AI to recreate PDF pages as semantic HTML from a page image, extracted text, and an ASCII layout preview.
skill.summary: Generate semantic HTML pages from PDF images, extracted text, and ASCII structure previews.
skill.author: AbeJitsu

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, fenced examples, fixed relative stylesheet links, and validation prose. The remaining risks are contextual: the workflow sends document content to an external AI API and does not explicitly require HTML escaping for untrusted extracted text.

remediation.issue: Document images and extracted text may be sent to the Claude API.
remediation.suggestion: Add a consent and redaction step before API use, and document data handling requirements for private documents.

remediation.issue: Generated HTML does not explicitly escape source text.
remediation.suggestion: Require escaping for source text characters such as less-than, greater-than, ampersand, quotes, and apostrophes before insertion into HTML.

remediation.issue: The local verification command depends on a project script path.
remediation.suggestion: State the trusted script location and allowed arguments so agents do not run an unexpected verifier file.

semantic_findings.title: External AI API Receives Document Content
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs the agent to invoke the Claude API with a PNG image, parsed JSON, and ASCII preview. This can transmit document content and metadata outside the local workspace without an explicit consent or redaction step.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow explicitly says to invoke the Claude API and attach parsed document data. The risk is contextual privacy exposure, not hidden exfiltration.

semantic_findings.title: Generated HTML Lacks Explicit Escaping Requirement
semantic_findings.description: The prompt requires all extracted text to appear in generated HTML but does not require escaping HTML special characters from the source data. Untrusted PDF text could become active markup if the generated file is served or opened in a browser.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The content-preservation rules are clear, and I found no matching sanitizer or escaping rule in the skill. Legitimate documents may be safe, so this is a medium-confidence design risk.

content.user_title: Generate Semantic HTML from PDF Pages
content.value_statement: PDF page conversion often loses structure, text boundaries, and layout intent. This skill combines visual, text, and ASCII inputs to guide precise semantic HTML generation.
actual_capabilities: Uses a rendered PDF page image, rich extraction JSON, and ASCII preview as generation context.
Defines a structured Claude prompt for semantic HTML5 page reconstruction.
Specifies CSS classes for headings, paragraphs, lists, exhibits, and page structure.
Requires strict page boundary rules to avoid invented bridging text.
Provides per-page text coverage verification guidance before chapter consolidation.
Describes expected HTML and generation metadata outputs.
limitations: Requires input files from earlier document processing steps.
Relies on an external AI model, which may require consent for private documents.
Generated HTML still needs deterministic validation before publication.
Layout accuracy may drop if the page image cannot be attached.

use_cases.title: Convert textbook pages
use_cases.description: Create semantic HTML pages from textbook PDF artifacts while preserving headings, lists, and page boundaries.

use_cases.title: Build document pipelines
use_cases.description: Use a repeatable prompt structure for converting extracted page data into reviewable HTML outputs.

use_cases.title: Review page reconstruction quality
use_cases.description: Check generated pages against coverage rules before allowing chapter consolidation or later validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Generate one page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner conversion of a single prepared page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate semantic HTML for page [page] using the PNG, rich extraction JSON, and ASCII preview. Preserve exact source text and page boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Fix coverage warning
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate repair after a coverage check reports missing or extra text.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review page [page] after coverage [percent]. Identify missing or extra text, then regenerate only that page with strict boundary rules.

prompt_templates.title: Handle exhibit content
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced page generation with tables, figures, or captions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create semantic HTML for page [page] with exhibits or tables. Use semantic elements only when supported by the three input files.

prompt_templates.title: Check chapter readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check all generated pages in chapter [chapter]. Confirm HTML structure, metadata, and passing per-page text verification before consolidation.

output_examples.input: A textbook chapter opening page with image, extraction data, and ASCII preview.
output_examples.output: A complete semantic HTML page with a chapter header, section navigation, stylesheet reference, and preserved source text.

output_examples.input: A page with paragraphs and bullet items from parsed extraction data.
output: Paragraphs are mapped to semantic paragraph elements.
Bullet groups are represented as list items.
No bridging text is added beyond source content.

output_examples.input: A generated page reports coverage above 100 percent during verification.
output_examples.output: The page is marked for immediate regeneration because it likely contains invented text.

best_practices: Provide all three inputs so the model can compare visual layout, extracted text, and structure.
Run per-page text verification before any chapter consolidation step.
Use the exact CSS class set so later validators can check the generated HTML consistently.
anti_patterns: Do not generate HTML from the image alone when extraction data is available.
Do not smooth incomplete page sentences with invented transition text.
Do not consolidate a chapter before every page passes individual coverage checks.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates semantic HTML5 for one PDF page using a page image, extracted text data, and an ASCII preview.

faq.question: Does it edit the original PDF?
faq.answer: No. It creates HTML output files and metadata from existing page artifacts.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: It expects a rendered PNG page, rich extraction JSON, and an ASCII structure preview.

faq.question: Can it work without the page image?
faq.answer: It can fall back to text-only generation, but visual layout accuracy may be lower.

faq.question: How is accuracy checked?
faq.answer: The workflow requires per-page text verification and treats extra or missing text as a regeneration trigger.

faq.question: Is it safe for private documents?
faq.answer: Use caution. The workflow may send document images and text to an AI API, so review policy and redact sensitive content first.
